The perpetrator was delicate and lacked physical strength, but with curves in all the right places, long legs, and a slim waist, she looked like a temptress.
The master slapped her thigh and lamented, “Turns out she was arched by a cabbage spirit!”
**Cabbage spirit: Implying a seductive and charming woman.

90904.synopsis:
Before being killed by her disciple, Yo Yo-hwa hears something unbelievable. He had returned to the past, and he knew that she had killed him multiple times before. But when she woke up after dying, she found out that she too had returned to the past—just like her disciple!
Now, the disciple is still the 13th Prince, treated as a useless outcast. However, knowing his overwhelming talent, Yo Yo-hwa makes up her mind:
I’m going to treat that crazy guy really well. Let’s pretend I didn’t return to the past. And when the time is right, I’ll escape.
Thanks to that decision, their relationship improves, and she thinks she might avoid getting killed this time.
But then, her disciple catches wind of her escape plan.
“Unbelievable. Last time, you killed me. The time before, you ignored me. Now that you’re finally acting all cute, you’re trying to run away?”

91160.synopsis:
The baseball novel I was enjoying has finally come to an end. But the heroine I was rooting for lost?
I couldn’t help but send the author a long note… 
When I came to my senses, I was in the novel.

92696.synopsis:
Jiang Shuyi has extended her graduation. The popular Alpha is crying uncontrollably, declaring that she hates her Omega advisor, Wen Yao, to death. To drown her sorrows, Jiang Shuyi gets drunk and, when she opens her eyes, finds herself 18 years in the past!
After transmigrating into the role of the rebellious second-generation heir during her professor’s high school years, 18-year-old Wen Yao collapses into Jiang Shuyi’s arms.
At this moment, Wen Yao has just differentiated into an Omega.
The scent of rose-scented pheromones fills the entire space.
Jiang Shuyi panics: I can’t possibly mark her…
Afterward, Jiang Shuyi kneels in front of Wen Yao, feeling ashamed.
“Professor— Wen Yao, I will take responsibility for you.”
“No need.”
Wen Yao turns away coldly, disappearing from her sight.
Jiang Shuyi: This woman is indeed cold.
But later on, Jiang Shuyi discovers:
Wen Yao always likes to hold her tightly during her heat.
Wen Yao secretly hides her clothes and cuddles with them at night.
Wen Yao’s phone only has her number saved.
Jiang Shuyi: Oh? I have reasonable doubts here…
————————————–
The second-generation heir of Chengbei High School, Jiang Shuyi, has been acting strangely lately. She no longer fights, climbs walls, or skips classes, and her grades have suddenly jumped to second in her grade. Plus, a pile of Omegas are confessing to her. On the day that the school beauty Jiang Shuyi once pursued confessed to her, everyone thought it was a sure thing. However, that night, someone saw the top student of the third year, Wen Yao, pinning her down on the table in the lab.
“Jiang Shuyi, are you going to accept that Omega?” Wen Yao asked coldly.
But the mechanical pencil in her hand was pressed against the Alpha’s carotid artery.
Jiang Shuyi immediately sat up and kissed the tears streaming down Wen Yao’s face. She nervously turned her neck away.
“Professor! I only want you!”
“What did you just call me?”
“Baby!” Jiang Shuyi quickly changed her tone nervously, “Baby! I only want you!”

95000.synopsis: From birth, Kwon Jiwook has lived life on his own terms, with striking looks that draw attention and fighting skills he wields without hesitation. At a club gathering for the new semester, his gaze is captured by a freshman.

97048.synopsis:
The one who fulfills my desires is the younger sister of the person I love―.
A love triangle between the perfect older sister and her care-free younger sister. I, Yuika Amamiya, confessed my feelings to my first love, Nagisa Hanafusa… but I was rejected. Unable to let go of my lingering feelings, Nagisa’s younger sister and my friend, Mimi-chan, made a surprising offer.
“I’ll help you forget all about my sister.”
She offered to let me do everything I had wanted to do with Nagisa — but do it to her instead.
I saw the shadow of the person I loved in her younger sister, and I started going on dates with Mimi-chan, dressed as Nagisa, and…
“Yuika-senpai, you’re about to kiss a dear friend who’s like a little sister, right?”
I indulged in my desires, almost drowning in them. As I spent more time with Mimi-chan, who was supposed to be a substitute for Nagisa, I found myself gradually falling for her―

98840.synopsis:
“I only trust myself. Don’t touch me.”
Kouki, who became a detective while hiding the fact that he belongs to the prestigious top Alpha Shutou family, ends up teaming up with the troublemaker Amane. At first, Kouki rebelled against Amane, who prefers to act alone and blatantly treats Kouki as a nuisance. However, when Kouki finds out that Amane is actually a Stray Omega, he becomes convinced that Amane is his ‘soulmate’. 
Although the two end up having a physical relationship due to their resonance heat, Amane’s emotional guard remains firmly in place, and Kouki feels a distance between them as partners. Then, Kouki’s ex-girlfriend asks him to investigate the truth behind a certain incident. Amane, who had lived their whole life believing that the only person he could trust was himself, suddenly feels jealousy for the first time!? 
An ultimate Omegaverse story of a possessive Alpha × a fake Beta (Stray Omega)!
Volume 1 – Resonance Heat: Omegaverse
Volume 2 – Resonance Lust: Omegaverse
Volume 3 – Resonance Passion: Omegaverse (Part 1)
Volume 4 – Resonance Passion: Omegaverse (Part 2)
associated_names: 共鳴劣情 オメガバース

99096.synopsis:
She transmigrated into a book.
The good news: She has a system with amazing rewards for completing tasks.
The bad news: It’s a prank system. What emperor wants to get jabbed with needles? What minister would willingly cross-dress? Which prince would ever agree to roll in the mud?
The worst news: She transmigrated into the role of bait for assassinating the tyrant, starting right in the middle of the assassination scene.
In her fury, Yuan Ruan lost her temper.
But what can a baby do? Lie down and accept it? Maybe she’ll get an early ticket to the underworld.
Yuan Ruan: Sigh, just one more cup of tea, and I’ll be thrown out as bait for the assassination. Life’s exhausting.
Unexpectedly, the emperor actually escaped the inevitable death. The accompanying general heroically saves her, presenting her as a gift to the emperor.
Yuan Ruan:
Wow, what a good person! I’ll never mock you as a cuckolded tyrant again.
Wait… Hold on tight! The tyr—um, His Majesty almost dropped me!
 ….
His Majesty adores his newly recognized little princess so much that he even brings her to court from time to time.
Initially, the ministers grumbled.
Until they overheard Yuan Ruan’s inner thoughts:
“Shocking! The Empress Dowager who just returned from worshipping at Wutai Mountain is actually a man!”
Emperor: !!!
The very next day, the Empress Dowager was exiled overnight by an enraged emperor, complete with the full “family annihilation” package.
“Unbelievable! A Chen Kingdom spy disguised as a cousin is hiding in the Minister of Works’ residence.”
Minister of Works: …
That same day, the minister’s mansion was surrounded by soldiers.
“The national treasury is empty? The system has a map of silver mines! Too bad I need the Minister of Revenue to cross-dress and attend court to unlock the reward.”
Minister of Revenue: …
That night, he was kidnapped by two ministers who were short of money. The next morning, the Minister of Revenue reluctantly appeared at court in women’s attire for an entire day.
associated_names: 崽被讀心後，暴君黑臉抓出男太後
崽被读心后，暴君黑脸抓出男太后

99352.synopsis:
“I’ll make you think of nothing but me.”
A week ago, she spent a passionate night with a man in this hotel suite. Though she thought it would be just a one-night encounter…
“I’m far better than that old man. In age, looks, wealth, and obviously… stamina. You know this well.”
Why is that man sitting at the next table during her arranged marriage meeting?
“Let’s get married. It’ll be the best choice for both of us.”
The man’s name is Kwon Si-heon, Executive Director of Hwanhee Group and its likely successor. He was someone from an unreachably high position.
“I hate wasting time. You need to save your family. We’re physically compatible. Need I explain more?”
“I have a request. When you become the successor… please divorce me.”
She wanted the same thing as him. For the first time, Si-heon finds himself intrigued by another person.
“Fine. Once I achieve what I want, we’ll divorce.”
***
Ga-eun hides her identity as an illegitimate child. Si-heon can only fall asleep by her side. As they enter their contract marriage while hiding their secrets, they find themselves increasingly drawn to each other.
“Want me to tie your tie?”
“You do it better, Mr. Kwon.”
“Exactly. That’s how we’ll look like a real married couple.”
Si-heon, who had avoided women and children due to past trauma and focused solely on work, pretends to be a loving husband to dispel rumors. However, his act gradually becomes genuine, though he desperately denies his feelings.
“Why do you dislike children?”
“I like you because we’re physically compatible, and second, because you know your place.”
“…”
“Don’t cross the line, Ga-eun. Just like always.”
While watching her husband who acts cold yet always falls asleep by her side, Ga-eun holds onto hope… Until the day she accidentally overhears his conversation with his grandfather, Chairman Kwon.

100120.synopsis:
To me, this world was nothing but a void of grayscale emptiness.
A meaningless life spent aimlessly, like a hamster running in a wheel.
One day, the woman who kidnapped me taught me about love and became the light of my life.
And then, she was kidnapped.

100376.synopsis:
Xing Shuishui transmigrated into a weak peach spirit.
To save her friend, she followed He Liansheng across thousands of mountains and waters. She witnessed him mercilessly capturing spirits, saw his fierce and cruel demeanor, and was even impatiently tied to a tree by him as he threatened: “Stop following me.”
Such a cold-hearted person surely couldn’t have any warmth in him.
From that day on, Xing Shuishui understood: if her identity was ever exposed, she couldn’t hesitate—she would have to strike him down ruthlessly to survive.
Spirits and celestial masters were never meant to walk the same path.
He Liansheng was Lingshan’s most outstanding celestial master.
—
On the day Xing Shuishui’s identity was exposed, spring rain fell cold.
She was cornered by Lingshan’s celestial masters, lying barely alive on the ground, soaked by rain.
No one expected that this most brilliant young man in Lingshan’s history would point his sword at his former master, standing before her protectively, using his wounded body to help her escape.
People said He Liansheng had gone mad, abandoning his beliefs for a mere spirit.
In the end, the person he protected stabbed a spirit blade through his heart, destroying his life’s only warmth.
—
For many years, they said He Liansheng was searching for someone. When he found them, they would suffer fate worse than death—everyone knew how twisted He Liansheng had become.
But when he finally found her.
Xing Shuishui cowered as she looked at him fearfully.
He Liansheng didn’t treat her with the same fierceness as before. Instead, he placed his hand beside her ear and said: “Xing Shuishui, I can be very gentle too.”
Damn it, stop running away. Even if you stab me a hundred more times, I won’t hate you.
At first glimpse, he seemed too cold-hearted.
But the world’s most cold-hearted person would go crazy for one person.
And for her, he would stand against the entire world.
—
Character Names:
– Xing Shuishui (刑水水) *水 means ‘water’*
– He Liansheng (赫连生)
One-line Summary: For you, I willingly face death; for you, I stand against the world
Theme: Face life with positivity and strive for continuous improvement each day

101400.synopsis:
Q: What was your motivation for applying to this high school?
A: Because my wife was going to go to school here.
I, who was already in my 30s, suddenly woke up and found myself back 15 years ago.
In front of me was my wife, Yuki, wearing a school uniform that I didn’t recognize.
Since we were supposed to meet only after becoming adults, we were still strangers at the moment
•
—But I knew everything.
I knew that at this time, she didn’t trust anyone, had no friends, and felt isolated.
I know how much she regretted those gray teenage years after becoming an adult.
Now, I’m going to change everything.
“Why do you know my personal secrets!?”
“Of course, because I’m your (future) husband.”
This is my story, of how I recolored my wife’s gray teenage years with my own colors.
associated_names: 彼女をデレさせる方法を、将来結婚する俺だけが知っている

101912.synopsis:
It all began when he had the misfortune of witnessing his beautiful older neighbor dragging a corpse into her apartment.
“Wouldn’t it be pitiful to just leave a dead person abandoned by the roadside?”
“Don’t talk about it like you’re picking up an abandoned kitten from a cardboard box!”
A male high school student surrounded by girls with somewhat twisted and dangerous personalities finds himself unwillingly drawn into a series of bizarre incidents—

106776.synopsis:
“Give me the strongest drink you have. Something that’ll get me completely wasted. I don’t want to think anymore.”
One day, a hero walked into my shop.
Her eyes were hollow, as if she had just finished crying.
associated_names: 퇴근한 히어로가 내 가게에 자꾸 찾아온다

110360.synopsis:
Xu Fei is a D-list actor with nothing to lose. The man who keeps coming back to him is a top-tier celebrity who doesn’t know how to say what he wants.
They understand each other, but only in bed. Outside of it, silence stretches, words fall short, and nothing ever changes.

110616.synopsis:
In his past life, he had a stunningly beautiful wife with immense power and influence. She gave him everything, just to earn a single glance from him. But he was foolish—he believed his adoptive father’s lies, stole confidential information from her company, called her a cheap woman desperate for affection, and forced her into a divorce.
In the end, after squeezing every bit of value out of him, that same adoptive father had him burned alive.
Now, reborn into a second life, facing the same manipulation and schemes from his adoptive father and elder brother, Xu Tian clings tightly to his wife’s leg and says:
“Wife, the weather’s getting cold… It’s time for the Xu Group to go bankrupt.”

112664.synopsis:
Failed the college entrance exam. Crushed. Dream, gone.
“If only I could become a girl…”
A random thought Su Yun muttered before bed actually… came true.
White hair, red eyes, standing at 160 cm tall. A face so cute it practically sparkled with moisture, and skin so pale it looked like it didn’t belong in this world.
“Isn’t this basically a vampire? A beautiful vampire girl, at that.”
…
“Siatet Xiaoyun, my house is pretty big. Come home with me… and drink my blood~”
On the empty school field, a tall, stunning beauty—recognized by everyone as the school’s number one campus belle—was clinging tightly to Su Yun’s arm, refusing to let go.
But she’s the real vampire here.
So why isn’t she afraid of me?
Ah—don’t touch me there!
associated_names: 弱气白发少女才不要被攻略

112920.synopsis:
At this school, there’s an idol. A beautiful girl who can do anything and is adored by everyone.
But I’m the only one who knows—there’s someone supporting her from the shadows.
That person is the truly amazing one. And yet, the idol treats him horribly.
She constantly dumps impossible tasks on him and does nothing herself. If something fails, it’s his fault. If it succeeds, she takes all the credit.
If this were one of the stories I love, someone like her would self-destruct eventually. So I waited—but it never happened.
“That’s why I’m going to make you happy.”
“E-Eh? M-Me…? I’m totally useless…”
“Don’t worry, I’ve been watching you. You’re incredible, and I will make you happy.”
“I-Impossible, impossible…”
“I’ll help you out. If you leave it to me, you could even end up in a harem ending.”
“Harem…? I might be dressed like a boy, but I’m actually…”
“Hmm? Did you say something, partner?”
“…Nothing. …Idiot.”
associated_names: もう遅い系の主人公みたいな奴がクラスメイトにいるのだが、一向に不幸なままなので俺が幸せにしてやんよ

115480.synopsis:
Yao Shi transmigrated from an apocalyptic world to the interstellar, where the original owner was dumped onto the insect-infested Planet T20.
The planet was teeming with countless mutated creatures with strong reproductive capabilities. Humans would be infected with parasites with one touch and turn into monsters, either spitting webs from their mouths, growing big eyes all over their bodies, scales on their faces, or incubating larvae under their skin.
Faced with infected patients, doctors and experts in the Empire had no effective treatment and could only wait for the victims to die.
They fell into the purgatory of despair until Yao Shi appeared, they finally saw the dawn of hope.
Yao Shi had the ability to cure patients by feeding them with what infected them. When facing mutated creatures, he whipped up various monster delicacies.
After the infected patients ate the monster delicacies made by Yao Shi, their tent**les fell off, their scales faded, and their compound eyes disappeared.
The first person in the Empire who could cure the infected appeared in the fallen zone. For a while, Yao Shi’s name resounded throughout the galaxy!
Later, Yao Shi put on the epaulets of the Empire’s general and stood on the podium side by side with the burly and handsome man he had taken a fancy to at first sight for the Empire’s greatest tribute.
Yao Shi: It’s my honor.
Lu Ting: It’s the Empire’s honor. You deserve all the glory.

117528.synopsis:
‘The Talent Spoon Theory’
He inherited the demonic personality and the powers of the True Ancestor.
associated_names: 나 혼자 만렙 뉴비 - 퓨어 블러드

117784.synopsis:
Yi Tian transmigrated to a beast mastery world and awakened the Simplified Beast Mastery System. As long as it had to do with beast mastery, it could be simplified.
He started by contracting a stone monkey with a drinking problem!
Heard the stone monkey had no evolution path? Fine, I’ll make one myself!
Add a staff, some armor, and a cloud to ride.
Nice, now that’s the vibe!
When the top geniuses saw the stone monkey smashing the heavens and earth with a single strike, their minds shattered.
Wasn’t it just a stone monkey? What’s with this Great Sage Equal to Heaven bullsh*t?
…
As one divine beast after another was created by Yi Tian’s hands, the whole world went nuts!
associated_names: 御兽：我有一个简化系统

118808.synopsis:
[Rebirth + Power Fantasy] 
Tang Chaoyang was bold, flamboyant, and unrestrained—fond of handsome men.
Fei Yan, a poor scholar from humble origins, entered the capital to take the imperial exams. The moment Chaoyang laid eyes on him, she fell deeply in love.
She forcefully ordered her men to seize him off the street and drag him to the hall for a wedding ceremony. From that night on, their passion burned endlessly.
A year later, Chaoyang gave birth to a son.
The old emperor passed away, and a new emperor took the throne.
Fei Yan transformed overnight—becoming the new emperor’s trusted Prime Minister.
He prepared a grand ten-mile wedding procession and married the daughter of the imperial tutor as his principal wife.
As for Tang Chaoyang, she was deemed disrespectful at court and, by imperial decree from the Empress Dowager, was exiled to the remote and bitterly cold Han City.
Her husband, Fei Yan, looked down on her with cold indifference and said:
“Chaoyang, if you’re willing to become a noble concubine, I can plead with His Majesty to let you stay in my estate. The hardships of Han City… you won’t survive them.”
But Tang Chaoyang refused to bow to fate. She took her son—who had run away from home to find her—and went to Han City. From that moment on, she never looked back.
Later on, the once lofty and noble Prime Minister—
knelt.
And Tang Chaoyang… had long since left him behind.
associated_names: You’re marrying a principal wife? Then I’ll bring my child into the palace and become Empress
你迎娶平妻？我帶崽入宮當皇後

119320.synopsis:
It has been 10 years since the “Tower of Infinity” appeared all over the world.
Kang Han, who has a strange body that becomes muscular even just by sleeping, awakened as the Heavenly Demon.
[Heavenly Demon Body Type (Rank: F~SSS)] 
But… the rank looked strange.
“Wait, is this weak or something?”
…No way.
[Notice: Player ‘Kang Han’ has become the first human to achieve an S-rank achievement.] 
[Notice: Player ‘Kang Han’ is the first human to……] 
Weak?
That was what his enemies thought.
He was the enemy of all those who stood against the Heavenly Demon.
associated_names: The Heavenly Horse Destroys the Tower

119832.synopsis:
Ye Jinyi, a bottom-tier corporate drone in the Celestial Court Group, was just another office tool. But one snowy night, while working overtime until 3 a.m., she was chosen to become a “world-class calamity” — and successfully shot to the top of the magical girl website’s most wanted list.
Now, her company wants to fire her, her landlord is urging her to pay rent, and the entire city’s magical girls are hunting her down.
associated_names: 魔法少女公敌？不要再逮捕我啦!

120856.synopsis:
Xu Chenglei is a man forged in violence and silence, a survivor of a world that chewed up the weak and made monsters out of the strong. Born into a brutal underground system where life was a currency and love a liability, Xu learned early that emotion was dangerous-but he never forgot how to feel it. Not completely.
Powerful, cold, and precise, Xu moves like a blade honed for war-disciplined, lethal, and unreadable. He wears gloves not for style, but necessity; the touch of skin brings him pain, memories, or worse. A past trauma-deep, unspoken, and unresolved-has carved into his nervous system a psychosomatic aversion to touch, leaving intimacy a battleground instead of a comfort. Still, he holds himself with unwavering control, a king in a fortress of his own making.
And yet-beneath the armor-there is grief. Guilt. Memory. A boy once dear to him who chose death so Xu could live. That sacrifice haunts him, not as a ghost, but as a debt.
Now, at twenty-nine, Xu is powerful enough to own anything, yet emptier than ever. When Liang Weiyang-a sickly, sharp-eyed teenager who eerily resembles his long-dead friend-is sold into his care, Xu is shaken. He tells himself it’s coincidence. He tells himself it’s pity. But what stirs in him isn’t pity. It’s a hunger to protect, to atone, to keep this boy safe in a way he couldn’t before. It’s a slow, unraveling tenderness-a kind of love that terrifies him more than any blade.
Xu doesn’t know if Liang is a second chance or a punishment. All he knows is he will destroy anything that threatens him.
Even himself.
—

123672.synopsis:
On the surface, he’s a modest gentleman—warm, compassionate, and unmatched in tenderness.
But beneath it all, he’s dark, unhinged, greedy, and lecherous.
A thousand-faced, crazy and unpredictable top × a clear-minded, grounded bottom.
⚠️ s*umbag gong warning — he’s scummy, but undeniably charming.
✔️ Power couple dynamics (yes)
✔️ Two gongs crossing paths (yes)
✔️ Chasing his wife (yes)
✔️ Getting beaten up by said wife (absolutely yes)

124696.synopsis:
On the eve of her graduation, with her friends watching, Sheng Wenyen makes a three-month pact to chase the handsome male lead!
The next day, her father, to temper her “spoiled princess” attitude, places her in a friend’s company for work experience. What a coincidence! Her direct boss turns out to be the male lead’s uncle. Believing that “getting on the good side of the senior is the best way to get on the good side of the junior,” Sheng Wenyen begins her journey of flattering her new boss.
Three months later— Her friends ask, “Didn’t you want to chase the male lead? How did you end up chasing his uncle?!” Sheng Wenyen is utterly confused and hesitates, “Maybe because… the uncle is better looking?”
Shen Zai is cold-hearted and impenetrable, so Sheng Wenyen’s friends fully expected her to fail in her pursuit. To comfort her, they constantly introduce her to handsome young men.
Later, at a party, they are shocked to see Shen Zai show up and pull a drunk Sheng Wenyen out of a crowd of guys. With a cold, intimidating gaze, Shen Zai asks, “Who told them to drink with her?” Her friends all look down, not daring to make a sound. Only a tipsy Sheng Wenyen, pushy and pampered, shoves him away, “Uncle, don’t meddle in us younger folks’ business, okay?”

155416.synopsis:
Did the assassination succeed? No, the assassin became the Immortal Lord’s spouse.
As the top assassin of the Shadow Clan in the Demon Realm, Gu Changhuai’s very first mission right out of the gate was to assassinate the leader of the righteous path.
—The renowned Qing Lian Immortal Lord, Rong Ye, whose single sword revealed the might of qiankun and whose fame shook the world, admired by countless people.
But Gu Changhuai was a transmigrator, so he knew full well that Qing Lian Immortal Lord Rong Ye was the greatest golden finger for the male protagonist in this novel called *Breaking Heaven*.
“…”
“!!!”
“???”
Gu Changhuai hesitated, Gu Changhuai panicked, Gu Changhuai wavered.
Just him? Alone?
To kill the male lead’s golden finger?
Haha, what a joke, folks.
But this mission meant death at the Demon Venerable’s hands if he refused, or death at Qing Lian Immortal Lord’s hands if he went. Caught between a rock and a hard place with no escape, after much deliberation, Gu Changhuai steeled himself and went for it.
…
Assassinating the leader of the righteous path, the male lead’s golden finger, and the world’s greatest sword cultivator was a long and arduous task.
First, he infiltrated the Xinnan Immortal Sect, conducting backstabs here and there while periodically sending the Demon Venerable assassination logs to prove he was diligently on the job.
The only weird thing was…
Why did he inexplicably end up lying on the same couch as Rong Ye in the middle of an assassination attempt?
The arm wrapped around his waist seemed to be pushing things in an unpredictable direction… Something was off.
Behind Gu Changhuai’s line of sight, Rong Ye—who should have been fast asleep—suddenly opened his eyes, a smile tugging at the corner of his lips.
He hooked a strand of Gu Changhuai’s inky hair around his finger, his dark gaze weaving threads like silken lines that silently cast a vast net in this tiny space.
Trapping the foolish moth that had flown straight into it.
The air seemed to fill with a strange madness and invasiveness, cool breaths sprinkling lightly on the nape of his neck, sending shivers down his spine.
Sensing the anomaly, Gu Changhuai shifted uneasily.
In an instant, Rong Ye’s arm tightened in the crook of his elbow, pulling the person in his embrace closer, locking him firmly in place.
The two men’s dark hair draped and intertwined on the couch in an unusually intimate tangle—
Now that he had come, there was no leaving.

161816.synopsis: Endymion Kyrian, a host gifted with innate talent, abandons his calling and comes to the capital with a single-minded desire to become a knight, ultimately joining the Swallow Knights. But something about this knighthood is fishy? The turbulent story of former host Mion, now a knight!

167192.synopsis:
But.
「Traitor spotted scaling the city walls under cover of night!」
「Dawn breach! plague carrier passes through South Gate… Who’s responsible?」
「Illegal drugs smuggled in bulk. South Gate’s gatekeeper dismissed.」
“…Wait. Every single one of these articles is dated tomorrow?”
The newspaper is a bit strange.
From the author of “SSS-Class Sui**de Hunter” and “I’m an Infinite Regressor, But I’ve Got Stories to Tell”.
associated_names: The Royal Capital’s Gatekeeper Reads the Newspaper
The Royal Sentinel has a Strange Newspaper

175640.synopsis:
Yustina Petrov, the eldest daughter of the Count’s house, raised in neglect.
One day, a small, precious creature appeared before her.
Small, soft, warm…… A little beast that was hers alone.
“Your name is Rus. It means ‘pure white.’”
On a day when pristine white snow was falling, Yustina bestowed a name upon her little one.
And from that day forward, everything began to change.

195096.synopsis:
“I am Seo Baekha, and I come from Joseon. I look forward to your guidance.”
Another hardcore role-player, huh?
With only two months left before the shutdown of the virtual reality game Destrosaver, Lee Seo—infamous as the ill-tempered #1-ranked player—encountered a newbie who claims to have come from Joseon.
He could just ignore him, but there was something distinctly suspicious about this Joseon role-player.
“Where’d you get that?”
“This garment?”

205592.synopsis:
After transmigrating into the body of the Qianlong Emperor’s pampered Concubine Chen, she decided to just let it all go.
Jiang Rao opened her eyes to find herself as the most arrogant Concubine Chen in the harem, held in the palm of the Emperor’s hand, where he would give her the stars if she asked for the moon.
Until that day at the hunting grounds, when the Fifth Prince shot a girl with an arrow, and the Emperor tremblingly asked that question—
“Is your mother… Xia Yuhe?”
The gr*pe in Jiang Rao’s hand went “plop” and fell.
Wait! Xia Yuhe from the banks of Daming Lake?!
Is this, for heaven’s sake, *My Fair Princess* (Huan Zhu Ge Ge)?!
Watching Xiao Yanzi enter the palace, Ziwei identify her father, and the Fragrant Concubine dance, the plot roared forward with great intensity.
Jiang Rao decisively chose: Eat melons, watch the show, and absolutely do not get involved!
But the Emperor insisted on provoking her—
“Rao’er, let me teach you how to read the memorials.”
“Rao’er, these pearls from the Southern Seas are only fit for you to wear.”
“Rao’er…”
Until the day Han Xiang entered the palace and the Emperor’s heart began to waver.
Jiang Rao sneered, packed her bags, and prepared to leave the palace: “Your Majesty, this concubine is tired.”
Qianlong finally panicked.
Later, the entire Forbidden City witnessed—
The Son of Heaven lurking outside Yongshou Palace every day:
“Rao’er, shall I tear down the Baoyue Pavilion?”
“Rao’er, look at the jasmine I just planted; doesn’t it look just like the one in your hair?”
“Rao’er… please don’t ignore me.”
Xiao Yanzi and the others were dumbfounded: So the pampered concubine was truly pampered, and the Emperor would actually kneel to win his wife back!
